message: You know those moments when you think to yourself, "I’m so glad I prepared for this!"? Well, having a solid plan and a well-stocked survival kit is one of those moments I cherish. I came across a great resource that lays out what to include—definitely worth checking out if you want that little extra peace of mind. After all, it's always better to be ready than to scramble last minute! What’s your go-to item for your emergency kit? 🤔
